snippet.title: Last Orbit Repairs – Early Trailer | Repair Androids Above a Dead Earth
snippet.description:
Last Orbit Repairs is a first-person robot repair sim where you diagnose and rebuild broken humanoid robots in orbit.

Wishlist it now: search "Last Orbit Repairs" on Steam.
Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/5615000/Last_Orbit_Repairs/?utm_source=youtube&utm_medium=shorts

Androids arrive by pod with a service ticket and a complaint. Read the ticket, open them up, find the fault, clean, test and replace parts, then run a final scan before sending them back. Get it wrong, and they come back. This is an EARLY work-in-progress build. Everything you see is still in development: there are bugs, rough animations, placeholder sounds and unfinished parts. Things will change a lot before release. I'm sharing it early to hear what you think.

#indiegame #simulation #repairgame #gamedev #scifi
